description: Awarding contracts for the rehabilitation and improvement of roads under the Rural Road Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Under the Rural Road Programme, bids have been invited following the national competitive procurement method to select contractors for the rehabilitation and improvement of five (05) rural road packages in the Western and Northern Provinces. Seventeen (17) bids have been submitted for the purpose. Based on recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee, following the evaluation of the said bids, approval has been granted at the                   Cabinet meeting held on 2026-09-21 to award contracts for three (03) of the five (05) packages. Based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee, regarding the bids received for the remaining two (02) packages, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to award the said contracts as follows, was approved by the Cabinet:

Awarding the contract for Package No.1, for the rehabilitation and improvement of rural roads in the Kalutara District of the Western Province, to M/s RR Construction (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.752.41 million (excluding Value Added Tax).


Awarding the contract for Package No.3 for the rehabilitation and improvement of rural roads in the Kalutara District of the Western Province to M/s RR Construction (Pvt) Ltd. for a sum of Rs.773.33 million (excluding Value Added Tax).
